interoperability_state: fragmented standards remain a structural coupling constraint
governance_state: Governance and oversight lag or fragment relative to capability; technical systems do not acquire legal authority.
trust_legitimacy_state: legitimacy is episodic and dependent on local accountability
cybersecurity_state: defensive capability is substantial but brittle across seams
workforce_state: maintenance and supply-chain mismatch remain persistent constraints
energy_compute_material_state: Energy/compute/material requirements remain explicit: maintenance and supply-chain mismatch remain persistent constraints
privacy_surveillance_state: Privacy and surveillance boundaries are contested, with observability sometimes increasing without legitimacy or control.
uncertainty: Uncertainty is high around coupled failure, public legitimacy, and legal basis, consent, interoperability, public trust, and institutional authority; no collapse is inferred.
evidence_basis: Phase 15A accepted/frozen baseline plus explicit scenario construction; this is a scenario state, not a forecast.
notes: Capability is not deployment; deployment is not adoption; adoption is not benefit. No basin-specific deployment is inferred from national or general evidence.
